name: lcn-agent
description: 可扩展的终端 AI Agent，支持本地演示、工具审批、会话和子代理

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:agents && npm run test:transports && npm run test:content
scripts.test:agents: node tests/model.mjs && npm run test:demo && node tests/subagent.mjs && npm run test:processes
scripts.test:transports: node tests/mcp-stdio.mjs && node tests/mcp-http.mjs && node tests/mcp-failures.mjs
scripts.test:content: node tests/mcp-content.mjs && node tests/web.mjs && node tests/search.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test:journeys: python3 tests/acceptance.py && node tests/skills.mjs && node tests/compaction.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:journeys && npm run test:package
